user_saw: Saving a skill API key (Skills page or a raw skills.update call) silently replaced the skill's SecretRef or ${VAR} with the plaintext key in openclaw.json and reported success.
summary: updateSkillConfigEntry now throws SkillApiKeyReferenceError when skills.update would replace an authored SecretRef or ${VAR} apiKey with plaintext, and the skills.update handler returns it as an INVALID_REQUEST error.
reasoning: The skills.update apiKey writer (`current.apiKey = trimmed`) predates the 2026-09-03 graft and dates back to the January 2026 gateway skills handler, when skill apiKey could only be a string. f6a854bd (2026-02-26, 'Secrets: add migrate rollback and skill ref support') changed `apiKey?: string` to `apiKey?: SecretInput` without teaching the writer to preserve references, so the overwrite appeared through a new usage. Issue #193149 reports the failure on 2026.10.9, and #197319 had already guarded only the UI side.
